events.venue: Rotana Ras Al Khaimah, The Mangroves
events.price_text: By invitation – RSVP on the official page
events.description: Quality of Life Series, edition 3, from the RAK Government Media Office and Heart of RAK. Two panels on what Ras Al Khaimah offers families: the school years, and what comes after Grade 12.

events.title: Al Ayyala Art Festival Operetta
events.description: Emirati heritage operetta with drums and traditional Al Ayyala chants. Idea by Abdulwahab Al-Wahabi, poetry by Abdullah Al-Hadiya, directed by Mohammed Haji. Supported by the UAE Ministry of Culture and the RAK Association for Arts and Folk Heritage.
